message.content: {"rules":["A TrustedRandomAccess implementor's size_hint must be exact.","A TrustedRandomAccess implementor's size_hint must be cheap to call.","A TrustedRandomAccess implementor must not override TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size.","All subtypes of a type implementing TrustedRandomAccess must also implement TrustedRandomAccess.","All supertypes of a type implementing TrustedRandomAccess must also implement TrustedRandomAccess.","If Self implements ExactSizeIterator, self.len() must always produce results consistent with self.size().","If Self implements Iterator, <Self as Iterator>::__iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx) must be safe to call when 0 <= idx < self.size(), the same index is never used more than once on self if Self: !Clone, subsequent next_back calls obey the self.size() - idx - 1 limit, and subsequent method use and coercions obey the restrictions below. For clones, the next_back limit applies individually, with next_back calls before cloning counting toward both the original and the clone. After the unchecked call, only Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size may be called on self or new clones. Coercions to supertypes are permitted, including multiple steps; resulting values remain subject to that method restriction, and unchecked-access and next_back counts are accumulated across coercion steps.","To use the guaranteed safety of <Self as Iterator>::__iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx) for Self: TrustedRandomAccess + Iterator, the caller must ensure 0 <= idx and idx < self.size().","To use the guaranteed safety of __iterator_get_unchecked on Self: TrustedRandomAccess + Iterator where Self: !Clone, the caller must not call it with the same index on self more than once; calls on values obtained by coercing self to supertypes, including through multiple coercion steps, count toward the same limit.","After __iterator_get_unchecked(idx) is called on Self: TrustedRandomAccess + Iterator, use within its guaranteed safety contract permits at most self.size() - idx - 1 subsequent next_back calls. If Self: Clone, this limit is calculated separately for self and each clone, but next_back calls before cloning count for both the original and the clone. Calls on values obtained through coercions to supertypes, including multiple coercion steps, are added to the corresponding count.","After __iterator_get_unchecked(idx) is called on Self: TrustedRandomAccess + Iterator, use within its guaranteed safety contract allows only Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size to be called on self or any new clones of self.","If Self: TrustedRandomAccess + Iterator is a subtype of T, self is allowed to be coerced to T, including after __iterator_get_unchecked(idx) has been called; multiple such coercion steps are allowed.","If self is coerced to a supertype after __iterator_get_unchecked(idx) has been called on Self: TrustedRandomAccess + Iterator, use within its guaranteed safety contract allows only Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size to be called on the resulting value, including values resulting from further coercions.","For Self: TrustedRandomAccess + Iterator, __iterator_get_unchecked must not change the value returned by size_hint when the caller satisfies the required index bounds, non-Clone index-uniqueness restriction, subsequent next_back limits, subsequent method-use restrictions, and accounting of calls across clones and coercions.","For Self: TrustedRandomAccess + Iterator, after __iterator_get_unchecked(idx), it must remain safe to call Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size on self, assuming the required traits are implemented and the caller satisfies the required index bounds, non-Clone index-uniqueness restriction, subsequent next_back limits, subsequent method-use restrictions, and accounting of calls across clones and coercions.","For Self: TrustedRandomAccess + Iterator, it must be safe to drop self after __iterator_get_unchecked(idx), provided the caller satisfies the required index bounds, non-Clone index-uniqueness restriction, subsequent next_back limits, subsequent method-use restrictions, and accounting of calls across clones and coercions.","For Self: TrustedRandomAccess + Iterator that is a subtype of T, it must be safe to coerce self to T after __iterator_get_unchecked(idx), provided the caller satisfies the required index bounds, non-Clone index-uniqueness restriction, subsequent next_back limits, subsequent method-use restrictions, and accounting of calls across clones and coercions."]}
